**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation or no-hire covenant on The Deerskin Companies, Inc. (or on HDI). I checked every plausible location:

- **Section 5.4** (General Managers) — appointment/liaison only, no personnel covenant.
- **Section 6 (Exclusivity)** — the only restrictive covenants: § 6.1 bars the Company from similar Internet projects during the term; § 6.3 bars HDI for two years post-expiry. Both are business-activity restrictions, not employee restrictions, and are the subject of a separate rule.
- **Section 8 (Confidentiality)** — mutual confidentiality only; the sole references to "employees" are in the public-domain carve-out (p0051) and the independent-contractor clause (p0061).
- Targeted searches for "solicit", "employ or engage / hire", "induce / recruit / personnel / staff" returned no hits, and a sweep of all "shall not" prohibitions turned up nothing on hiring.

Section 10.7's integration clause confirms nothing is imported from prior agreements. This satisfies the preferred element "Customer has no non-solicitation restriction," so no redline was proposed.
